jobs.description_text: If you want to put your skills to work where the stakes The Systems Engineer III – MSAD is responsible for contributing to the design, development, and analysis of modeling, simulation, and control systems supporting propulsion and aerospace systems. The role supports program execution through modeling, algorithm development, system-level performance assessments, and multidisciplinary collaboration, with increasing technical independence and ownership under the guidance of senior engineers. The position reports to the Engineering Department Manager and is part of the Strategic Systems department based in Folsom, CA. This role is hybrid and is located in Folsom, CA. jobs.description_text: Job Description The Account Managers are responsible for working directly with our customers to ensure full, continuous satisfaction with our solutions and services are met. The Account Manager’s ultimate goals are to drive customer engagement and readiness of our solutions in times of crisis. Their engagement activities are responsible for building strong customer relationships that promote customer retention as well as ensuring customers are aware of opportunities to better complete their unified notification solutions with simple, easy-to-deploy automated crisis response tools they may not yet have. The ideal candidate will possess strong communication and organizational skills. They will need a strong technical understanding of our products’ current capabilities and the drive to find out more about our customers’ needs to ensure that our solutions are meeting their expectations to the fullest. Travel to our Baltimore HQ is required for onboarding, trainings, and other in-person team/company activities. Candidates must be located in the Baltimore, MD area and/or within driving distance to our headquarters.

jobs.title: Senior UX Designer
jobs.description_text: Job Description Most design roles focus on a single feature or a specific interface. This is different. As a SeniorUX Designer here, you are a core architect of the "Whole Product" experience and the primary steward of our visual identity within our software. You won’t just be refining pixels; you will be sitting at the intersection of brand strategy, product vision, and technical feasibility. Working directly with our Product Development team, you will ensure our digital solutions are not only functional but are cohesive and easy to use. Your mission is to ensure that as our technical capabilities scale, our user experience remains intuitive, unified, and aligned with our brand. Candidates must be located within driving distance from our Baltimore HQ.

jobs.title: Technical Support Analyst II (Hardware & Field Service)
jobs.description_text: Job Description We are looking for a motivated troubleshooter to play a critical role in driving Alertus' rapid growth. Reporting to the Technical Support Manager, the Technical Support Analyst II role combines remote technical assistance with on-site deployment and hardware troubleshooting, serving as a key resource for customer project startups, field diagnostics, and hardware replacement. Our ideal candidate is a technical, versatile problem-solver with a strong desire to always provide the best and most efficient customer service. This position requires frequent travel to customer sites (up to 50%), with occasional adjustment of work hours to support project schedules. *This is an office-based role when not traveling to customer sites.

jobs.title: Account Manager Enterprise Partnerships, California/Washington
jobs.description_text: Healthcare is changing, and local medical practices are caught in the middle. They are trying to shift from a system that rewards the volume of procedures to one that rewards the quality of patient care—but navigating that shift is incredibly tough. That’s where you come in. As our Account Manager, you will be the ultimate strategic partner, business coach, and advocate for the medical practices in your portfolio. You are the day-to-day anchor of these relationships, responsible for diving into the data, identifying performance gaps, and working hand-in-hand with doctors and healthcare executives. By helping them master Value-Based Care (VBC) contracts, you directly drive financial success (shared savings) and, most importantly, measurably better health outcomes for the community. Note on Travel: On-site check-ins are key to this role. You can expect to travel in-person approximately 1x per month per account for 2–3 days (supporting accounts in Northern California and the Seattle, Washington area). Exact schedules flex based on client needs, meaning some months may feel lighter or heavier than others. Location Requirement: This is a remote role, but candidates must be based on the West Coast (preferably within driving distance or short regional flight access to Northern California or the Seattle, WA area) to accommodate monthly client visits.

jobs.title: Care Manager, Michigan
jobs.description_text: The Care Manager will work with primary care practices as a part of the Provider Delivered Care Management Program (PDCMP). The Care Manager collaborates with the care team within each practice and leverages Aledade’s interdisciplinary care team to provide telephone-based health coaching, quality improvement, and care coordination. The Care Manager works closely with patients to support them in becoming active in their health care by better understanding their chronic conditions, helping them access care in the most appropriate setting, and improving quality of care. Care Managers utilize Aledade’s proprietary population health tool, the “Aledade App” to manage high-risk patients, using real-time data to identify and intervene on high utilizers who could benefit from more preventative and active management. Location Requirement: This is a remote role within Michigan. Candidates must be based in the state of Michigan to be considered. Salary Range: $70,000 to $87,000 base + bonus + equity Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience.

jobs.title: Clinical Outreach Specialist
jobs.description_text: As a Clinical Outreach Specialist, you will serve as a vital clinical bridge for high-risk patients, utilizing your clinical expertise to navigate the critical window between hospital discharge and home recovery. In this high-impact, telephonic role, you will perform complex medication reconciliations, identify looming clinical red flags, and proactively close care gaps to prevent unnecessary ER visits and readmissions. By blending empathetic patient education with data-driven population health tools, you will empower patients to manage their health effectively while collaborating directly with primary care practices to ensure no one falls through the cracks of the healthcare system. We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home across US time zones.

jobs.title: Encounter Data Submissions Program Manager (remote)
jobs.description_text: The Encounter Data Submissions Program Manager will assist in the development of an end to end Encounter Data Submission and Reconciliation program, to include creation of program guide and standard operating procedures. The program manager will collaborate across teams to better understand and evaluate ROI of existing Alternate Submission Method (ASM) workstreams, as well as potential ROI improvements as a result of workflow efficiencies and enhancements. Additionally, once established, the program manager will oversee daily EDS and reconciliation processes. This Manager will lead the design and implementation of Aledade’s end-to-end Encounter Data Submission and Reconciliation program, including the creation of comprehensive program guides and Standard Operating Procedures. You will act as a cross-functional leader, evaluating the ROI of existing Alternate Submission Method (ASM) workstreams and driving workflow enhancements that directly improve data accuracy and operational efficiency. Once established, you will provide oversight of the daily EDS and reconciliation processes, ensuring that clinical encounter data—the lifeblood of value-based care—is accurately captured, validated, and submitted to payers and CMS with total integrity. We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home within the US.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant, Remote
jobs.description_text: The Executive Assistant (EA) serves as a strategic executive business partner supporting 3-4 assigned senior leadership members (SVPs+). Moving beyond traditional administrative support, the EA leverages organizational insight to optimize executive efficacy, proactively mitigate operational risks, and streamline cross-functional workflows. Operating in a fast-paced environment, this role acts as a trusted gatekeeper and operational liaison, ensuring leadership focus remains strictly aligned with company priorities.

jobs.title: Executive Director, Enterprise Partnerships, Minnesota
jobs.description_text: Executive Directors, Enterprise Partnerships are the business leads for large, strategic hospital and health system accounts. They act as a link between the field and Aledade Centralized support teams, focusing on ACO-specific business operations. Executive Directors partner with Medical Directors to align clinical initiatives with savings goals and provide the business case and direction for field team practice interactions. The Executive Director, Enterprise Partnerships, will be pivotal in building Aledade’s service model in the Minnesota market and beyond for a core group of strategic partners.

jobs.title: Outreach Specialist, CACP
jobs.description_text: The CACP Outreach Specialist is the first step in the patient journey and supports the Comprehensive Advance Care Planning (CACP) program through high-volume inbound and outbound outreach. The role primarily manages outbound scheduling and inbound inquiries; educates patients about CACP; addresses reluctance with empathy and professionalism; and schedules facilitation appointments. The specialist follows approved scripts, workflows, SOPs, job aids, privacy requirements, and quality standards while balancing patient-centered service with daily performance expectations. We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home across US time zones. The wage for this position is: $24.52 USD per hour. This range represents the expected base pay for the role across all U.S. locations, based on market data and internal benchmarking. Aledade offers a competitive total rewards package, which includes a company bonus, equity, 401k match, healthcare coverage and a broad range of other benefits. A full review of our total rewards package will be discussed at the offer stage with the selected candidate.

jobs.title: Payer Operations Analyst
jobs.description_text: The Payer Data Operations Analyst ensures data quality, accuracy, and reliability across payer data pipelines to support value-based contract performance. This role applies technical data skills and cross-functional leadership to resolve complex data issues, build proactive monitoring solutions, and partner with internal teams and payers to continuously enhance end-to-end data integrity.

jobs.title: Pharmacy Outreach Specialist (Remote)
jobs.description_text: As a Pharmacy Outreach Specialist, you'll be a vital link between patients, providers, and pharmacies, helping people stay on track with the medications that keep them healthy. In this role, you'll combine empathy, problem-solving, and clear communication to break down the real-world barriers that keep patients from taking their medications as prescribed, from cost concerns to simple forgetfulness. Your work directly improves patient health outcomes and contributes to pharmacy quality measures that matter across the healthcare system, all while building valuable skills in patient engagement, pharmacy operations, and healthcare communication.

jobs.title: Practice Transformation Specialist, Florida Panhandle
jobs.description_text: Join Aledade as a Practice Transformation Specialist (PTS) for our Florida practices and personally make an impact on patient care. Practice Transformation Specialists are HQ’s most direct interface with providers and can glean valuable insight into our partner practice’s happiness and needs. A successful PTS is passionate about population health, and highly mission oriented around providing better care to patients while reducing costs. At Aledade, a PTS can impact the health of their community by transforming one practice at a time. Please note: candidates must be based in Florida to be considered. Note on Travel: This is primarily a remote role, but on-site check-ins are key. You can expect to travel in-person approximately 1x per month per practice. Exact schedules flex based on practice needs, meaning some months may be lighter or heavier than others. Salary Range: $65,000-$75,000 base + bonuses + equity Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Implementation (Launch)
jobs.description_text: The Program Manager (Launch)is responsible for leading the program workstreams that guide partner practices through Aledade's onboarding journey to achieve sustained success in value-based care. Operating with a high degree of autonomy, this role structures, executes, and monitors assigned launch initiatives, establishing clear milestones and task structures aligned with overall program objectives to maintain project timelines. By leveraging data-driven governance and program discipline, the Program Manager ensures full transparency into launch progress and identifies potential roadblocks early. Core responsibilities include designing workstream operational frameworks, defining and monitoring key performance indicators (KPIs), proactively mitigating risks, and driving strategic alignment across Sales, Field, Implementation, and Product teams. The Program Manager facilitates cross-functional execution and directly oversees key launch deliverables to meet organizational goals. Combining strong organizational leadership with deep healthcare technology expertise, the ideal candidate thrives in dynamic environments to advance Aledade's mission in value-based care.

jobs.title: Program Specialist, CMMI Programs

This role is responsible for the intricate management and refinement of core program processes, ensuring seamless execution across all facets of CMMI models (LEAD & REACH). The Specialist will play a key role in analyzing program performance, identifying opportunities for optimization, and collaborating with diverse internal teams to implement innovative solutions that enhance engagement and outcomes within the CMMI model framework. This position is central to translating strategic vision into operational reality, driving the continuous improvement and successful scaling of CMMI models. Candidates should be comfortable working remotely from anywhere within the US, across all US time zones. Salary Range: $80,000—$92,000 base + bonus + equity Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience.

The ideal candidate will work independently to advise on privacy risk, own key privacy verticals end-to-end, and serve as a trusted advisor to internal stakeholders on evolving privacy and AI regulatory issues. The successful candidate must bring strong legal judgment, confidence using AI tools to work efficiently, and enthusiasm for advising the business on emerging AI laws and governance frameworks. We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home within the US or be based from Bethesda, MD office.

jobs.description_text: As a Senior Security Engineer II at Aledade, we play a central role in helping secure our enterprise, cloud native environments, and applications. We’re looking for security engineers that understand data and automation are important ingredients to our mission and know how to actively employ these ingredients at scale. Beyond the technical expertise, we value individuals who can partner cross-functionally across various teams, driving impactful outcomes and further securing our digital landscape. We prioritize Security-as-Code and API-first automation over manual administration, building resilient identity pipelines that scale seamlessly with our growth.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer I - Data & Algorithm Engineering
jobs.description_text: As a Senior Software Engineer I at Aledade, we maintain, improve, and expand our data models and Databricks pipelines. We're looking for engineers who know that writing new code is not always the solution to a problem, but when technological changes are needed they create secure, maintainable, performant, correct, scalable, and stable solutions to the complex and unique challenges in our corner of the healthcare industry. The Patient Domain Team is responsible for turning complex health care data into well-defined insights about our patients that describes who they are and how they interact with the health care system. We are responsible for telling our partner practices more about who their patients are and how to ensure they receive the care they need. We are also responsible for figuring out how to monitor and observe our models in action to ensure they are driving impact across the company.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II - Risk
jobs.description_text: As a Senior Software Engineer II at Aledade, we maintain, improve, and expand our web application and data pipelines. We're looking for engineers who know that writing new code is not always the solution to a problem, but when technological changes are needed they create secure, maintainable, performant, correct, scalable, and stable solutions to the complex and unique challenges in our corner of the healthcare industry. They embrace strategies that minimize risk, leaning towards observability, alerting, metrics, high test coverage, and frequent releases that incrementally build value.
